punchline: Young laid a photo over his drawing so the errors showed up as gaps he could see.
thirty_sec: Scott Young spent 30 days learning to draw portraits, about 100 hours on pencil and paper. He used GIMP to overlay reference photos on his drawings and kept changing the drill, from 15-minute line drawings to 20-second ones. He reports the results himself on his own site.
question: What is one thing you practice regularly, and how long until you find out what went wrong?
key_contrast: A visible gap versus a feeling that it looks right.
